list: Official 55-trophy list, verified 2026-11-19 against Exophase (via Planet GTA 6), cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden.
sources: Exophase GTA VI PS5 trophy list (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags)
PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list (grade and PSN progress counts)
TrueAchievements GTA VI achievement list (cross-check of names and Gamerscore)
PowerPyx GTA 6 trophy guide (platinum time estimate, cheats disable trophies, missable warning)
OutputLag GTA 6 trophy list (meditation missable detail, no mission replay)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here at all. Treat it as the finish line of the whole roadmap: finish the story, work through the side strands and activities, then sweep up the collectibles and the big grinds like 250 stunts and 100 percent completion. When it unlocks, you are done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: This is the first story trophy and it cannot be missed. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing as Jason until the mission-complete screen appears. It is a gentle introduction to driving, the open world of Leonida and the duo at the heart of the story, so just follow the on-screen objectives and enjoy the ride.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Keep playing the main story until Chapter 1 closes. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the chapter ends, so there is nothing extra to do and nothing you can miss. If you are chasing the one reported missable trophy, do Lucia's balcony meditation during this chapter before it ends, because that spot is reported to vanish afterwards.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter wraps up. By now both Jason and Lucia are playable, and most of the map's side content opens up too, so this is a good moment to start ticking off activities and collectibles between missions instead of leaving them all for after the credits.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end and the trophy unlocks on its own. Nothing here is missable, so push on with the story at your own pace. If you have been saving side content for later, keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway: the game has no mission replay, so a spare save is cheap insurance for anything you later wish you had done.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy is yours. As with the other chapter trophies, it unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. By this point the story is heading toward its endgame, so before the final mission, make a manual save: it protects the reported missable meditation spot and lets you mop up anything story-gated without replaying the whole game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy unlocks. It is unmissable: every player who reaches the credits earns it. Do not turn on any cheat before the credits, because cheats disable trophies and block saving. After the story ends, the open world stays open for the long cleanup toward 100 percent completion.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: PowerPyx via Planet GTA 6 (cheats disable trophies)

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one unlock automatically when the mission ends, so there is no extra objective to chase and no way to miss it. Just play the mission through to its conclusion and the trophy pops on the results screen.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist to completion. This is one of the big set-piece missions of the story, and like every mission trophy it unlocks by itself when the mission ends. There is no optional objective tied to it, so focus on surviving the heist and following the mission beats rather than hunting for anything extra.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play and the trophy unlocks automatically. Mission trophies cannot be missed, so there is no need to replay the mission or meet any special condition. If you are tracking your progress, tick this one off as soon as the mission-complete screen shows and move on to the next story beat.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It unlocks on its own when the mission ends, like every other mission trophy, so there is no hidden requirement and no way to miss it. Play it straight through and the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. This is a story mission, so the trophy unlocks automatically at the end of it and cannot be missed. The airport setting is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy lives, so while you are here, remember that an unscheduled departure from VCIA is worth trying on a later visit.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play Operation Savage Glory through to its end and the trophy unlocks with the mission-complete screen. It is a story mission trophy, so it is unmissable and needs no extra objective. Expect a heavy combat sequence, and keep a manual save before starting in case you want a clean retry.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion checklist, which appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story. Progress made before the story ends still counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. This is the longest grind in the game, around 200 hours for the platinum in total, and it folds in the stunts, WAiNK spots, card sets, meditation spots, garages and bank vaults, so chase those trophies first and watch the percentage climb.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near misses, airtime and the rest, as the game counts them. The count is cumulative, so every stunt you land while roaming adds up, and the counter keeps running across the whole playthrough. Do a few stunts on every drive instead of leaving all 250 for the endgame, and the total will be most of the way there by the time the story ends.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once: racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them, just try each one. Open the activities list in the pause menu and tick them off one by one; the ones you already tried while exploring will already count.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, the count PSNProfiles tracks for this trophy. Each challenge is a short timed shooting trial, so learn the target pattern, take your time on the first run to memorise it, then push for the gold time or score. Replaying a challenge costs nothing, so keep retrying the ones you miss until every challenge shows gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the drone race locations around Leonida. Each location is its own race, so you must win everywhere, not just once. Learn the course on a first run, then race it cleanly: smooth lines and steady throttle beat risky shortcuts on most courses, and a win at every location is what the trophy counts.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the game's race types. Only wins count, and each race counts once, so variety matters more than repeating one easy race. Work through the race list methodically, note which ones you have already won, and try a different vehicle class or route when a race keeps beating you instead of grinding the same loss.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing challenges reward patience and timing more than fancy gear: watch the line tension, reel in steadily when the fish runs, and ease off before the line snaps. You can practise the fishing minigame on your own first, then challenge Cal once the rhythm of reeling and resting feels natural.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game in one of the arcades around Leonida. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most and play it to its end screen rather than quitting halfway. Arcade games are short, so this is one of the quickest trophies in the list and a good early win while you are exploring Vice City.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until his final mission is done. Stranger mission strands unlock as you meet the character and complete each of their missions in turn, so keep returning to Andy whenever his icon appears on the map. The trophy pops when his last mission ends, and no part of the strand is missable.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands progress one mission at a time, with new missions appearing as the story advances, so check the map for Kenton's marker between story chapters. The trophy unlocks automatically when his last mission completes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Like the other stranger strands, it opens up mission by mission as you explore and as the story moves forward. Keep an eye on the map for Billy's marker, finish each mission he offers, and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands, including Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Each strand is a chain of missions for one character, and you need eight complete chains. Strands unlock gradually, so roam the map, answer every stranger marker you see, and finish each chain before moving on; the silver pops when the eighth strand closes.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission. Stranger missions appear over time as the story progresses, so if Randy has no mission for you yet, keep playing the main story and check back. The trophy unlocks when his last mission ends, and the strand counts toward the eight needed for Strangers and Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Tyrone's missions unlock one at a time as you progress, so revisit his marker whenever it appears and work through his chain in order. The trophy pops on completion of his last mission and counts as one of the eight stranger strands for the silver trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida: 18 spots across 10 locations, split between Jason and Lucia. This is the one trophy reported as possibly missable, because Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 is said to disappear after that chapter, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate at every spot you find as soon as you find it, keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, and never leave a spot for later.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Unique hunts are about finding the right animal in the right place, so follow Bret's clues, move quietly, and take the shot when you have a clear line. The trophy pops once the hunt is complete, and the animal is unique, so there is no second chance at the same target in the same playthrough.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden across Leonida, so pick up every card you spot while exploring and keep a note of which sets are nearly complete. Sets are finished card by card, so focus on the set with the fewest cards missing first, and sweep the map region by region rather than wandering at random.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread all over the map, so this is a slow exploration grind rather than a single task: open WAiNK whenever you arrive somewhere new and the count climbs on its own. Keep a rough tally of which regions you have covered, and sweep the quieter corners of the map last, since the final spots are usually the ones far from the main roads.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small optional objectives, and they add up across every type, so you do not need to master one category. Try a bit of everything, and the counter will climb steadily; by the time you have finished the activities and stunts, you will be well on your way to 50 without ever grinding one challenge type alone.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a four-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Four stars brings helicopters and roadblocks, so plan your escape before you earn the stars: pick a quiet area with good roads, keep a fast car nearby, and break line of sight before hiding. The trophy pops once the wanted level clears with your partner still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Do not let the heat drop between robberies: move fast from one shop to the next, keep the cops at a distance rather than losing them, and pick three shops close together so the run stays short. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Every new vehicle you find, drive or spot counts toward the total, so variety is the whole game: try cars, bikes, boats and aircraft wherever you find them, and check the less-travelled areas for the rarer ones. The counter climbs naturally as you explore, and it pairs well with registering vehicles for the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up before you activate it: find a spot with at least five enemies close together, make sure you have enough ammunition, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly while it lasts. A busy shootout is the best place to try, and if you fall short, reload a save and try a better position.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way: get yourself and a plane off the ground without going through the normal departure routine. The airport is fenced and guarded, so plan the route in, grab an aircraft on the tarmac, and take off before security closes in. It is a stunt more than a mission, so a fast approach and a quicker takeoff are what matter.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, so the trophy is about getting into one and making the most of it. Steal or commandeer a Rhino, then cause the chaos the trophy's name promises: drive it through the streets, shrug off the police response, and enjoy the armour. The exact trigger is not pinned down in public guides yet, so treat a long, destructive joyride in a Rhino as the way to pop it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly, without any detection. Go in quiet, move fast, and get out before anyone raises the alarm: avoid cameras and guards, take only what you need, and have your getaway vehicle ready outside. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out, since a clean run is what the trophy counts.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults are the biggest robbery jobs in the game, so plan each one: scout the bank, bring the right tools, and know your escape route before you go in. You must escape cleanly after the robbery for it to count, so a fast car and a route away from the police are as important as the vault itself.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the roads of Leonida, rob it, and escape with the cash. Armored trucks travel set routes, so watch for one, block it or force it to stop, then grab the money and break away before the police response builds. A fast getaway car parked nearby turns a messy robbery into a clean escape, and the trophy pops once you are clear.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every named area of Leonida, from Vice City and Ocean Beach to the swamps, keys and back roads of the state. The trophy counts exploration, so drive, fly and sail into each region rather than sticking to the highways. Open the map and look for the areas you have never entered, then make a point of visiting them one by one until the whole state is covered.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each gang in Leonida. Gangs control different corners of the state, so you will need to find each gang's operation, hit it, and get out. Work through the gangs one at a time, note which ones you have already robbed, and save this trophy for after the story, when the whole map and every gang's turf are open to you.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. The description is the whole clue: find a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water, sit down with a drink, and let the moment play out. This is one of the quiet hidden trophies, so slow down, take in the sunset, and the trophy should pop while you are soaking it in.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out through the glass of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style the description promises. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a car inside or lined up outside, then put your foot down and smash through. The exact showroom is not pinned down in public guides yet, so try the most prominent showroom in Vice City first and enjoy the noise.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt and Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper game: the description's follow-through is the clue, so play through a full game and see it to the end rather than quitting after one frame. Bowling is one of the game's quieter activities, so take your time, aim carefully, and the trophy should pop when the game finishes.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description points at a partnership moment with mass appeal, which most likely means doing something big together with your partner in front of a crowd. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down in public guides, so keep playing the duo's story and side content together, and watch for a moment where the two of you steal the show in public. When it happens, the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that shape your Criminal Profile, the game's running record of the decisions you make. PSNProfiles reports this trophy as a long running tally, reported as 500 actions, so there is no single choice to hunt for: just keep playing, keep making decisions, and the count climbs on its own. It is a slow burn, so expect it to pop late, near the end of a long playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try at something you first failed. The description is the clue: fail once, then succeed at the same thing on your next attempt. The exact activity is not pinned down in public guides yet, so the honest advice is to play naturally and let it come: any retry you win after a first failure is a candidate, and the trophy pops when the game counts one.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in the world of Leonida. This is the game's weird-encounter trophy: a strange event, a bizarre sight, or something that makes you stop and stare. The exact encounter is not yet pinned down in public guides, so explore the odd corners of the map, poke at anything unusual, and keep playing: the trophy pops when you stumble into the right strange moment.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle: a melee drive-by. Get a vehicle moving at a steady speed beside a pedestrian, then swing a melee weapon as you pass. It takes timing more than speed, so go slow enough to aim and fast enough to count as a drive-by. A quiet street with few police around is the best place to practise.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder 250,000 dollars of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash, so keep robbing and keep laundering: every bank vault, armored truck and shop robbery feeds this total. The count is cumulative, so it climbs alongside the robbery trophies, and it pops once a quarter of a million dollars has been washed.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all the shops of Leonida. Every purchase counts toward the total, so buy what you actually need as you play: weapons, ammunition, clothes, food and vehicle upgrades all add up. It is a cumulative total across every shop, so it will be most of the way there by the end of a long playthrough without ever needing a shopping spree.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game cash, so save up as you play and buy each one as it becomes available rather than spending everything on cars first. Check the property listings on the map, visit each garage, and purchase them one by one; the trophy pops when the last garage changes hands.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register each one through the app on your in-game phone. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive rather than hunting rare cars: hop in, open the app, register, and move on to the next. The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot
